framework.cell: rhombohedral primitive cell, 144 atoms, heights 14.07 A

gm: quasi-planar Pt8 anchored to the supercage wall by four Pt-O 2.25 A contacts (one Pt bidentate), Pt-Si >= 2.81 A; binding to the frozen framework -3.3 eV
notes: Pilot: 10 seeds x BH/RS, 40k steps (campaign pilot-bze1). Size scan (BH/RS ERT): Pt10 is easy for RS (1.7k) because its GM floats in the supercage without wall contact, Pt8 chosen. 17/20 runs reached the GM (energy spread 2.9 meV), no competing minimum within 0.08 eV. Budget = 3 x median BH hit (4.0k) = 12k steps (~2 min/run). NEP89 compresses the Si-O-Si angles by ~7 deg vs the IZA CIF (134-141 vs 142-146 deg) at the same volume; NEP89 is not fitted to metal/zeolite interfaces, cluster-framework binding is qualitative.
